name: Dexible v2 selfSwap arbitrary router call
summary: Dexible v2's selfSwap() forwarded a caller-supplied router address and calldata without an allowlist, so the attacker pointed it at ERC20 contracts and had Dexible transferFrom the balances of every wallet still holding an approval to it.
notes: The proxy constructor selected the vulnerable Dexible implementation; no proposal or completed implementation upgrade occurred before the exploit.
Dexible reported $2,047,635.17 taken from 17 approved wallets across Ethereum and Arbitrum. This is the reported gross incident total.
The reported loss is a combined Ethereum-and-Arbitrum incident total; the source does not publish per-asset quantities.
